verification_command: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; img=decipher-hc-check-$$; ctr=${img}-ctr; cleanup(){ docker rm -f "$ctr" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker rmi "$img" -f >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; docker build -t "$img" scenarios/docker-healthcheck-failure/expected -q >/dev/null; docker run -d --name "$ctr" "$img" >/dev/null; for _ in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do status=$(docker inspect --format="{{.State.Health.Status}}" "$ctr" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$status" = "healthy" ]; then echo PASS; exit 0; fi; sleep 3; done; echo FAIL'
